key_findings: The supplied Disciplinary steps workbook is a blank historical matrix: violation labels are populated, but 1st/2nd/3rd-offense point/date cells contain no values.
The archive preserves two unlabeled legacy discipline point ladders plus attendance point examples; their scope and relationship to the 2023 handbook remain unresolved.
Historical disciplinary-action logs were maintained by fiscal year and AAP-sorted derivatives were created for multiple years.
The archive has no supplied 2024-2025 fiscal-year disciplinary-action workbook despite adjacent periods being represented.

A 2015 restricted employee-case memo contains an explicit historical company-wide statement against extending scheduled vacation with adjacent personal/sick leave; only that generalized policy statement was promoted.
Filename type/date cannot be trusted as authoritative: content-first classification/date validation is required.
Exhaustive source-level audit mapped every restricted artifact to generalized knowledge or an explicit corroborative/aggregate disposition; no restricted source remains silently unanalyzed.

The historical fiscal disciplinary registers contain 1,193 populated event rows and evolved into a mixed discipline-plus-vehicle-incident ledger; from 2016-2017 onward Incident counts exactly match vehicle-accident/incident reason counts.

AAP-sorted workbooks are not uniformly equivalent copies. One 2016-2017 variant systematically changes 99 EEO classifications, including 96 category-7 to category-9 transitions; another 2016-2017 variant instead largely preserves source classifications and adds subtotal rows.
The 2014-2015 AAP derivative omits two source events; 2019-2020 omits two name occurrences and adds one; 2020-2021 adds one occurrence. Several other years contain smaller field discrepancies.
No formulas were detected in any of the 29 disciplinary/AAP/verbal-warning workbooks; historical subgroup totals in AAP sheets are hard-coded.
The fiscal register has four header layouts, 13 blank TYPE entries, 276 distinct free-text reason strings, inconsistent department/job-title aliases, and no exact duplicate rows.
Same-person/same-date is not a safe duplicate key: 24 groups contain multiple distinct records, including 13 groups that also share the same reason text.

Historical warning/counseling practice used informal personnel-file notes, counseling records and formal multi-signature Employee Warning Notices with improvement plans, consequences, acknowledgement and employee-comment fields.

The old 9/10-point attendance system is superseded by the current December 15, 2025 six-point attendance policy; the historical vacation-adjacent personal/sick-leave restriction is independently corroborated by the current handbook.

The medical/attendance packet demonstrates a restricted evidence-handling pattern combining an attendance calendar with informal communications, provider-document images and contextual evidence; medical content remains excluded from generalized knowledge.
Filename-derived type/date is demonstrably unreliable and content-first classification/date validation remains required.

The undated Disciplinary steps matrix encodes historical HSTD/CSR workflow fragments including KY HealthNet eligibility checks, denial tracking, prior authorization, supporting statements, escorts, trip processing, client confirmation/denial communication, HSTD rule lookup and timely 500/501 updates; these are preserved as candidates pending procedural corroboration.

Seven restricted disciplinary artifacts use the same standardized Employee Warning Notice structure, including warning/offense grids, infraction/improvement/consequence sections, management/HR approval, employee comments and acknowledgement language that receipt/understanding does not necessarily mean agreement.
A separate machine-readable coverage ledger now proves all 95 archive artifacts have an explicit disposition and knowledge destination, with zero artifacts left in an unreviewed state.
notes: Restricted personnel, medical, disciplinary, incident, schedule, and participant-list content was not committed to GitHub.
The fraud-alert DOCX and signed PDF are preserved as two artifact variants of one source family.
Historical external links, vendor arrangements, benefit coverage statements, point rules, routing chains, and role-specific instructions require current verification before operational use.
analysis_boundary: Exhaustive for the 95 supplied artifacts and their cross-comparison with already-indexed RTEC sources. Unresolved current-state questions require newer/authoritative sources rather than further re-reading of this archive.
